snippet.title: Latin Shadows - The Visitor (Trailer)
snippet.description:
#terror #retrogame #pombero #paraguay #indiegame 

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3797670/Latin_Shadows__The_Visitor/

The Game
A short psychological horror experience inspired by folklore. After a simple gathering at a friend’s house, you soon realize the night hides something watching you from the shadows. What begins as an ordinary evening turns into a chilling tale where your decisions determine the ending.

The Gameplay
Play in first-person for full immersion or with fixed cameras for a tense, cinematic experience. Explore the environment, uncover story details, and make choices that lead to multiple outcomes.

Key Features
* Multiple endings based on your decisions.
* Playable in first-person or with fixed-camera perspectives.
* An atmospheric story inspired by Guaraní mythology.
* Short, narrative-driven horror with high replay value.
* Immersive sound design that amplifies the fear.
